slides.title: Signal is locking AI assistants out of your private chats.
Signal vs. Siri and Gemini
slides.body: Signal says built-in phone AI assistants can read what's on your screen. So it's now blocking them from seeing your chats on iPhone and Android.

slides.title: It watches for AI peeking
slides.body: On Android, Signal turns on its Screen security setting when it detects an AI assistant trying to read the screen. On iPhone, there's a new "Block Siri AI" setting.

slides.title: Signal admits it's not perfect
slides.body: It can't reliably block screenshots on Mac. And it says AI agents could still reach app data in sneakier ways, like through files already on your device.

slides.title: You can turn it off
slides.body: But Signal warns that doing so could expose your messages, and your contacts' messages, to these AI agents.

slides.title: Your phone's AI vs. your privacy
slides.body:
AI assistants that see everything on your screen are becoming normal. Apps are starting to fight back.
